stage: stage3 choices and cohort (sealed and committed before any non-published next-slice outcome)

policies.name: actual profit
policies.formula: the highest centre net among E(s, c); ties by the higher selection robust net, the lower centre DD, then the label

policies.name: tail-mean-constrained actual profit
policies.formula: admissible iff the selection family’s worst-10% mean DD (mean of the ⌈0.1 n⌉ largest of the pooled, de-duplicated 2 × 128 selection draws’ maximum minute DDs) ≤ $35,000; the admissible member with the highest centre net (profit order); none admissible → no selection

policies.name: best-year-excluded neighbourhood profit
policies.formula: the highest median over the pooled selection draws of (draw net − the draw’s best calendar-year marked P&L); ties by profit order

policies.name: profit without new funding in the leading episode
policies.formula: the highest causal centre net from a rerun refusing every new decision inside the largest winning pool-level episode (first decision session → last exit; no winning episode → the centre net); ties by profit order
